ablation.name: distinct5_512_ema_variant_m_style_gated_content_router_e3
ablation.notes: Variant K plus a target-style gate on the content-adaptive VQ atom-logit residual. The gate is motivated by K/L matrix diagnosis: Minimalism gains little style from the router but pays a large LPIPS cost. No DINO, CLIP supervision, classifier, or external semantic features.
